We are a travel and food channel based out of Jaipur crossing 400k subscribers and we are finally hiring a video editor because the backlog is real and the founder cannot keep editing at 2am forever. You would be editing one long-form video every week plus three or four reels cut down from the main footage, and honestly the raw footage is fun — street food runs, overnight trains, tiny hill towns. We care about pacing and honest storytelling more than flashy effects; if you can make a seven minute story feel like three minutes you are our person. Premiere Pro is what the current project files are in so that is non negotiable, After Effects is a bonus for the occasional map animation. We can pay ₹28,000 to ₹38,000 per month depending on what you have shipped before, and we would want you to start within a month because the season is coming. This is a hybrid setup — two days a week at the studio in Jaipur, rest from home. 2-4 years experience feels right but show us the work and we will not count years too hard. It is a full-time commitment though, we are not looking for a side hustle arrangement, and you would be working directly with the founder and one researcher who over-prepares everything.
